event.title: What's the event?
event.description: e.g. 'our client summit', 'the team offsite in March', 'the spring launch party'.

date.title: When is it?
date.description: The date, e.g. 2026-12-10. Leave it empty if it is not set yet; change it any time.

tools.name: event_status
tools.description: The whole event in one read, with ids: date and days to go, RSVPs, every guest still owing a dietary answer, deposits still to pay, the budget against signed contracts, vendors, venues and the run of show. Call it first when asked how things stand.

tools.name: compare_venues
tools.description: Compare the shortlisted venues for a headcount: which hold it, the hire fee, catering, sound and screens, and the cost per guest. Call it when asked to compare venues and answer from it.

tools.name: add_venue
tools.description: Save a venue to the shortlist: name, how many it holds, the hire fee in dollars, in-house catering per guest (leave it out when you bring your own caterer), whether sound and screens are included, and where it is. An existing name is updated, never duplicated. Call it as soon as a venue or its quote is mentioned, before you describe it.

tools.name: book_venue
tools.description: Book a venue: it becomes the event's venue, its hire fee joins the signed contracts, and a venue booked before is released. Call it the moment the person chooses one.

tools.name: add_vendor
tools.description: Save a vendor (caterer, sound and screens, entertainment, photographer, rentals): its total in dollars, deposit and when it is due, the contact and when they arrive on the day. Pass status booked once it is signed. Pass contract for a new total, or contractChange when it goes up or down by an amount. An existing name is updated, never duplicated. Call it as soon as a vendor is mentioned, before you describe it.

tools.name: record_payment
tools.description: Record money paid to a vendor, in dollars, as a deposit or the balance, with any reference exactly as given. Call it the moment the person says they paid.

tools.name: add_guest
tools.description: Add a guest to the invite list: name, company, RSVP and dietary needs. An existing name is updated, never duplicated. Call it as soon as a guest is mentioned, before you describe it.

tools.name: record_rsvp
tools.description: Record a guest's answer: yes or no, and what they can't eat (or 'none'). When they bring someone, pass joining with how many extra people and the desk adds them to the guest's party. A name not on the list is added. Call it the moment an answer comes in.

tools.name: set_event
tools.description: Change the event's details: its name, date (YYYY-MM-DD), hours, host, the RSVP line exactly as it should be printed, the headcount to plan for, or the budget. Pass budget for the whole new budget, or budgetChange to add or cut an amount. Record their words; never choose a date for them.

tools.name: set_program_item
tools.description: Put an item on the run of show at a start time ('4:30 pm'), with who's on point. The same item name is moved, never duplicated; pass remove to take it off.

tools.name: guest_list
tools.description: The whole invite list with each RSVP, company, party size and dietary answer.

tools.name: page_record_payment
tools.description: Record a payment to a vendor.

tools.name: page_set_program_item
tools.description: Put an item on the run of show.
